title: Channelization & Dredging of System 1 (Odo Iya-Alaro to Lagoon)
target: De-flooding Kosofe, Maryland, and upstream catchment areas
description: Comprehensive desilting and channelization of the primary System 1 drainage corridor to ensure unimpeded stormwater conveyance into the Lagos Lagoon.

title: System 4 Drainage Channel Expansion (Aguda / Surulere)
target: Mitigation of perennial surface flooding in Aguda & Surulere
description: Concrete lining and expansion of System 4 secondary and primary collector drains to protect thousands of residential and commercial properties.

title: System 5 Primary Channel Reconstruction (Lekki / Ikate Corridor)
target: Permanent flood prevention along the Lekki-Epe expressway corridor
description: Full dredging, widening, and concrete embankment reinforcement of System 5 canal discharging into the Osapa / Ikate natural wetlands.

title: Statewide Tree Greening & Urban Canopy Initiative (LASPARK)
target: Planting 100,000 native economic and canopy trees by 2027
description: Joint initiative with LASPARK and private sector partners under the 'My Tree Challenge' to combat urban heat island effect and increase carbon sequestration.

title: Material Recovery Facility (MRF) Agbowa Waste-to-Wealth Plant
target: Processing 500 metric tons of recyclable plastic and organic waste daily
description: State-of-the-art sorting and processing facility reducing landfill burden at Olusosun and Solous sites, promoting the circular economy.

title: System 6c Canal Desilting (Ketu - Alapere Corridor)
target: Restoration of stormwater velocity towards Ogudu foreshore
description: Removal of aquatic vegetation, illegal encroachments, and silt deposits along the Ketu-Alapere arterial drainage line.

title: Statewide Zero Open Defecation Public Sanitation Infrastructure
target: Construction of 120 standardized eco-friendly public sanitation blocks
description: Executive environmental hygiene project enforcing Executive Order E0/BOS/01 and eliminating open defecation across key commercial centers.

title: Continuous Air Quality Monitoring Sensors Network (LASEPA)
target: Real-time PM2.5 and AQI data generation for public health warnings
description: Deployment of 20 high-precision solar-powered continuous air quality stations across high-traffic and industrial corridors in Lagos State.
